author: mmusich
body:
backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52098

#### PR description:

Title says it all. Also add the new variables in the HLT nano (and corresponding DQM).
In order to so, I have to support writing out ParT scores to jet value maps to be consumed in the HLT nano module.

#### PR validation:

Run successfully `runTheMatrix.py -l ph2_hlt` (and verified the new variables get filled).

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

almost verbatim backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52098 to CMSSW_17_0_X
title: [17.0.X] Swap `DeepTau` based reconstruction for `ParT` one in NGT Scouting menu
